clips.title: What Is Expected of an Idol

lines.ja: アイドルには清廉性が求められる、
lines.en: Purity is expected of an idol.
lines.speaker: Lawyer

lines.ja: そういう仕事だと分かっていたはずですよね？
lines.en: You must have known that's what the job is, right?
lines.speaker: Lawyer

lines.ja: 子供の頃から、アイドルに憧れていました。
lines.en: Ever since I was a child, I dreamed of being an idol.
lines.speaker: Female Defendant

clips.title: Idol Rules and Contract
grammar: できるだけ — as much as possible
〜てきた — have done up to now

lines.ja: 外での飲み会とアルコールも禁止、
lines.en: No drinking parties outside and no alcohol.
lines.speaker: Manager

lines.ja: 配信はできるだけする。
lines.en: Livestream as much as you can.
lines.speaker: Manager

lines.ja: オーディションの時言ってたよね。
lines.en: You told us during your audition, right?
lines.speaker: Producer

lines.ja: 子供の頃から、アイドルに憧れてきたって。
lines.en: That you'd dreamed of being an idol since you were a kid.
lines.speaker: Producer

lines.ja: 賠償金、どうやって払うんだよ！
lines.en: The damages! How are you going to pay them?!
lines.speaker: Man

lines.ja: いつか返せばいいじゃん！
lines.en: I can just pay it back someday!
lines.speaker: Woman

lines.ja: お前はさ、何と戦ってんの？
lines.en: What on earth are you fighting against?
lines.speaker: Man

lines.ja: もう、自分の気持ちに嘘をつくのが嫌だったからです。
lines.en: Because I was sick of lying to my own feelings.
lines.speaker: Woman
